name: Rolls-Royce Holdings plc
why_them: EXCLUDED under the defence sector rule, so do not pursue. Rolls-Royce has a large Defence division. Its 2025 annual report shows Defence underlying revenue of £4,772m out of £20,059m group underlying revenue, about 24% (my calculation, not a figure the report states). The Defence division covers Submarines, Combat, Naval, Transport and Helicopters. Scores if the exclusion were ignored: Capacity 2, Programmatic Fit 2, Strategic Relevance 1. Capacity is 2 because of group revenue above £20bn. Programmatic Fit is 2 because the company has a global goal of inspiring 25 million people by 2030, and STEM is the largest share of its community giving. It runs the Rolls-Royce Schools Prize for Science & Technology, which has a £5,000 overall prize. It has about 1,400 STEM Ambassadors, a Discovery Education primary schools partnership, and Teach First sponsorship. Strategic Relevance is 1 because its giving appears to be run in-house, through its own programmes and existing partners, rather than through open external grants. These figures are self-reported by the company and partners. I did not find a current annual giving total or a formal external STEM grants programme. I did not check the Nonprofit's annual reports, so I have not confirmed whether Rolls-Royce is an existing partner.
